description: This file defines the BuilderRecord class used for managing dependency loading and resolution in a build system, including dependency tracking, resolution status, and dependency management methods.

classes.name: BuilderRecord
classes.description: Represents a record in the build dependency graph, managing dependencies, resolution status, and related metadata.

methods.name: BuilderRecord
methods.description: Constructor initializing a build record with type, label, and reference node.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the build record.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the build record.

methods.name: GetNameForType
methods.description: Returns a string name for a given ItemType.

methods.name: IsItemOfType
methods.description: Checks if a given item matches a specified ItemType.

methods.name: TypeOfItem
methods.description: Returns the ItemType of a given item.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Returns the associated Item pointer.

methods.name: set_item
methods.description: Sets the associated Item pointer.

methods.name: originally_referenced_from
methods.description: Returns the ParseNode from which this item was originally referenced.

methods.name: should_generate
methods.description: Indicates whether the build record should generate output.

methods.name: set_should_generate
methods.description: Sets the should_generate flag.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Returns whether the record has been resolved.

methods.name: set_resolved
methods.description: Sets the resolved status.

methods.name: can_resolve
methods.description: Checks if the record can be resolved.

methods.name: can_write
methods.description: Checks if the record is ready to be written.

methods.name: all_deps
methods.description: Returns the set of all dependencies.

methods.name: GetSortedUnresolvedDeps
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unresolved dependencies.

methods.name: waiting_on_definition
methods.description: Returns dependencies waiting on this record's definition.

methods.name: waiting_on_resolution
methods.description: Returns dependencies waiting on this record's resolution.

methods.name: waiting_on_resolution_for_writing
methods.description: Returns dependencies waiting on this record's resolution before writing.

methods.name: validation_deps
methods.description: Returns validation dependencies.

methods.name: AddDep
methods.description: Adds a dependency record.

methods.name: AddGenDep
methods.description: Adds a generated dependency record.

methods.name: AddValidationDep
methods.description: Adds a validation dependency record.

methods.name: OnDefinedDep
methods.description: Notifies the record that a dependency has been defined.

methods.name: OnResolvedDep
methods.description: Notifies the record that a dependency has been resolved.

methods.name: OnResolvedValidationDep
methods.description: Notifies the record that a validation dependency has been resolved.
